acceptance: join_type matches DuckDB's Join Type for inner, left, right, full, semi, anti, mark and their right variants, with a test per type
Sort keys are split per key with the correct direction on the JSON parse path
The fingerprint version policy for the change is decided and applied
Published DuckDB plan companions are regenerated or flagged
description: Found 2026-11-11 by the local review of PR 4127 and confirmed in results-data/bundles/tpch_sf01_duckdb_sql_20261111_154211_a31c24ca.plans.json (TPC-H SF 0.1, DuckDB 1.5.5, estimated EXPLAIN, JSON parse path). Structured join_type against the raw "Join Type" kept in join_conditions, over 76 join nodes: 56 INNER correct; recorded as inner: 3 RIGHT, 1 LEFT, 3 SEMI, 2 RIGHT_SEMI, 1 ANTI, 1 RIGHT_ANTI, 2 MARK; recorded as left: 1 ANTI, 1 SEMI; recorded as right: 1 RIGHT_SEMI, 1 RIGHT_ANTI. Examples: Q13 outer join, Q4/Q18/Q20 semi joins, Q21 anti joins, Q16 mark joins, Q22 right anti join. Cause: DuckDBQueryPlanParser._extract_join_type_from_operator (benchbox/core/query_plans/parsers/duckdb.py:451) reads the type from the physical operator name (HASH_JOIN) and falls back to inner; it never reads the Join Type detail. Sort: all 18 sort keys have direction ASC, and 10 of them carry an expr ending in DESC (Q2, Q3, Q5, Q9, Q10, Q11, Q13, Q16, Q18, Q21). Cause: the JSON path at duckdb.py:152 hard-codes direction ASC and stores the whole ORDER BY list as one key; the text path already parses per-key directions. Impact: the Explorer plan viewer prints the wrong Join and sort direction beside the raw detail that contradicts it, and both fields feed the structural signature (query_plan_models.py _structural_signature_obj), so plan fingerprints do not distinguish an inner from a semi or anti hash join and will change when this is fixed. A fix needs a fingerprint_version decision and regenerated companions for any published DuckDB plan bundle.
